title: About movietrailer.channel
description: Who runs MovieTrailer.Channel, how we choose the films we cover, and how the site pays for itself.

blocks.text: MovieTrailer.Channel is a guide to films worth watching again, and where to watch them tonight. Each film page has the official trailer, a short write-up, the facts that help you decide (length, US rating, how it was received) and where to rent, buy or stream it in the US.
Who runs it

The site is run by Simon Farrugia in Melbourne, Australia, and published by Independent Media Network Pty Ltd. It's independent: no studio, streaming service or retailer owns it or decides what we cover.
How we choose films

We focus on older films people still go looking for, rather than this week's releases. A film earns a page when people are actively searching for where to watch it, and when it can actually be rented, bought or streamed. Collections are built the same way: one idea (a director, a decade, a genre night) and the films that best fit it.

Some classic films are in the public domain in the United States. For those we play the full film free, only to US visitors, and show the evidence that it's free to watch on the film's page. We check that list every week.
How the write-ups are made

Film facts (cast, runtime, rating, box office) come from published film databases. Write-ups are drafted with the help of AI writing tools, then checked against those facts before they go live. If you spot something wrong, tell us and we'll fix it.
How the site pays for itself

Some links to Amazon and Prime Video are affiliate links: if you rent or buy through them we may earn a small commission, at no extra cost to you. We may also show ads. Neither changes which films we cover or what we say about them. A share of what the site earns goes towards making original films.
Get in touch

blocks.html: Corrections, trailer submissions and questions: contact us.

title: Contact Us
description: Get in touch with movietrailer.channel for submissions, partnerships, or general inquiries.

blocks.text: Whether you're an indie filmmaker looking to submit a trailer, a distributor or sponsor interested in placements, or just have a question — we'd love to hear from you.
We read every message and usually reply within a few days. Useful things to include:
Trailer submissions: the film's title, year, a YouTube link to the official trailer, and where it can be rented, bought or streamed in the US.
Corrections: the page link and what's wrong (a wrong trailer, an out-of-date streaming link or a typo). We fix errors quickly.
Partnerships and sponsorship: who you are and what you have in mind. Sponsored placements are always labelled.
movietrailer.channel is published by Independent Media Network Pty Ltd, Melbourne, Australia.

blocks.text: Last updated: September 2026
By using movietrailer.channel, you agree to the following terms.
Content

Trailers embedded on this site are hosted on and streamed directly from YouTube. We do not host video files ourselves. All movie titles, images, and trailer content remain the property of their respective studios and rights holders.
Affiliate Disclosure
This site participates in affiliate programs. Purchases made through our "Rent or Buy" links may earn us a commission at no extra cost to you.
Indie Submissions

Submitting a trailer for consideration does not guarantee inclusion in our catalog or stream rotation. Paid placements are non-refundable once a listing has gone live. We reserve the right to decline or remove any submission at our discretion.
No Warranty
This site is provided "as is." We make reasonable efforts to keep information (ratings, availability, release dates) accurate, but cannot guarantee it, since this data is sourced from third parties.
Contact
Questions about these terms can be sent to hello@movietrailer.channel.
Last updated: 31 October 2026
This policy explains what information movietrailer.channel collects and how it's used. We aim to collect as little personal data as possible.
Analytics

blocks.html: We use Google Analytics (GA4) to understand how visitors use our site — pages viewed, general location, device type, and interactions like poll votes or button clicks. This data is aggregated and does not identify you personally. You can opt out of Google Analytics tracking using the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

blocks.text: Cookies & Local Storage

We use your browser's local storage to remember whether you've already voted on a movie's "Would you watch this?" poll, so you don't see it repeatedly. This data stays on your device and is not linked to your identity.
Advertising

blocks.html: We use Google AdSense to show ads. Google and its partners use cookies to show ads based on your visits to this and other websites, and to measure them. You can turn off personalised ads in Google’s Ads Settings, and read how Google uses cookies in advertising.

blocks.text: Affiliate Links

Some links on this site (e.g. "Rent or Buy" buttons) are affiliate links. If you make a purchase through one, we may earn a commission, at no extra cost to you. We do not receive any information about you personally from these transactions.
Indie Submissions

If you submit a trailer for consideration, we collect your name, email address, and any details you provide, along with payment information processed securely through Stripe (we do not store your card details ourselves). This information is used solely to process your submission and is not sold or shared with third parties.
Original films updates

If you sign up for news about our original films, we store your email address, when you signed up and the page you signed up on. We only use it to email you news about the films we fund, and every email has an unsubscribe link. We never sell or share your email address. To have your details deleted, email hello@movietrailer.channel.
Filmmaker pitches

If you pitch us a film, we store your name, email, project title, logline and the link you send, and use them only to consider your pitch and reply. Email hello@movietrailer.channel to have a pitch deleted.
Contact
Questions about this policy can be sent to hello@movietrailer.channel.
